scope: Owned GPU PIDs summed at the same timestamp; sampled bound, not an instantaneous hard guarantee

probe.timing_scope: Imports separately measured. Sample frame decoding/input preparation is outside both timers. Native timer includes one frame constant setup and same batch partition; candidate includes FrameBaker first CUDA context, frame uploads, CPU source_world projection, Torch masks/RGB/dilation and downloads. Comparisons outside both timers. Full export timer includes input loading/LOD/encoding/writing too. No pre-timer CUDA synchronization.
probe.counts_scope: rgb_uploads/depth_uploads count one .to(device) per frame (CPU mode has no H2D)
